decisions.reason: The button, switch, and touch connector inventory remains unchanged; the statement that button connector pin 1 stays GND confirms existing wiring while the changed pull resistors belong to the separate input-biasing Requirement.
The source changes input biasing and active polarity but does not change any GPIO assignment.
The source does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module, variant, part number, or pin count.
Input resistor topology does not alter breakout coverage, placement, connector style, pitch, or platform reuse.
The references to pull-ups, pull-downs, 3.3V, and GND concern panel and sensor inputs, not the e-paper backlight circuit.
The necessary VRTC and VBACKUP effects are already captured by the candidate's complete same-message MODIFY at message 887, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The source does not change the 5V boost converter, its enable GPIO, default state, or powered loads.
The source discusses button, PIR, and touch input biasing and does not alter addressable-LED power or data logic.
Confirming input pull resistors does not change the standalone USB supply, rail membership, source selection, or regulator behavior.
The source does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
The source contains no decision about the passive buzzer type, selected part, sourcing, or interface.
The pull-up and pull-down changes apply to discrete button and sensor GPIO inputs, not the I2C pull-ups or series-resistor topology.
